record.edic_text:
3133 maraino {mar-ah'-ee-no}

of uncertain affinity;; v

AV - fade away 1; 1

1) to extinguish (a flame, fire, light, etc.)
2) to render arid, make to waste away, consume away, perish
3) to have a miserable end
